Verify Computational Reproducibility Against a Capsule Manifest

Source: R/verify.R
verify_capsule.Rd

Audits a recorded capsule.json manifest by:

  1. Verifying cryptographic manifest integrity (content_digest and optional HMAC-SHA256 signature).

  2. Verifying SHA-256 hashes of all recorded inputs and scripts.

  3. Staging a clean isolated workspace strictly excluding previously generated outputs and re-executing the pipeline in either a deterministic local sandbox (runner = "sandbox" via callr::rscript()) or a live Docker container (runner = "docker").

  4. Comparing every freshly generated output against the manifest using exact SHA-256 comparison and configured numeric-tolerance comparators for CSV, TSV, JSON, and RDS artifacts.

Usage

verify_capsule(
  manifest,
  path = ".",
  runner = c("sandbox", "docker"),
  entrypoint = NULL,
  seed = NULL,
  tolerances = NULL,
  key = NULL,
  env_vars = list(),
  timeout = 300,
  docker_image = NULL,
  docker_tag = NULL,
  keep_sandbox = FALSE,
  reference_dir = NULL,
  strict_outputs = FALSE,
  scrub_secrets = TRUE
)

Arguments

manifest

An rcapsule_manifest object or file path to capsule.json.

path

Path to the project root directory. Defaults to ".".

runner

Execution isolation backend: "sandbox" (default; runs locally in a clean temporary directory via callr::rscript without requiring a Docker daemon) or "docker" (executes inside a Docker container).

entrypoint

Optional runnable script/document override (defaults to manifest$project$entrypoint).

seed

Optional RNG seed override (defaults to manifest$rng$seed).

tolerances

Optional tolerance override (same structure accepted by create_capsule_manifest()). Defaults to manifest$tolerances.

key

Optional HMAC-SHA256 key to verify a signed manifest.

env_vars

Optional named list of extra environment variables passed to the isolated run.

timeout

Execution timeout in seconds (default 300).

docker_image

Optional pre-built Docker image reference for runner = "docker". If NULL, builds from Dockerfile in path.

docker_tag

Optional tag used when building the Docker image.

keep_sandbox

Logical; if TRUE, retains the temporary sandbox directory on disk and records its path for debugging. Defaults to FALSE.

reference_dir

Optional directory containing verified baseline output files for numeric-tolerance comparison (defaults to path; only used if a baseline file's SHA-256 matches the manifest).

strict_outputs

Logical; if TRUE, fails verification when the pipeline produces unexpected extra artifacts not declared in manifest$artifacts$outputs. Defaults to FALSE (extra artifacts are still detected and reported in extra_artifacts).

scrub_secrets

Logical; if TRUE (default), strips ambient credential and token environment variables (AWS_*, GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, *_SECRET*, *_TOKEN*, etc.) before launching the isolated sandbox subprocess.

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_verification containing status ("verified_exact", "verified_within_tolerance", or "failed"), passed (logical), runner, verified_at, duration_sec, exit_status, manifest_integrity, input_checks, script_checks, output_checks, extra_artifacts, scrubbed_env_vars, failure_reasons, rng, environment, stdout, stderr, sandbox_dir, and manifest.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_verify_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines(
  c("df <- data.frame(id = 1:3, val = rnorm(3))",
    "write.csv(df, 'result.csv', row.names = FALSE)"),
  file.path(tmp, "run.R")
)
set.seed(123)
write.csv(data.frame(id = 1:3, val = rnorm(3)), file.path(tmp, "result.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
m <- create_capsule_manifest(tmp, outputs = "result.csv", seed = 123L)
res <- verify_capsule(m, path = tmp, runner = "sandbox")
res$status
#> [1] "verified_exact"
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
